prompt:
Some people think that employers should be encouraged to keep and to hire workers who are over sixty. Others believe that the posts available should go to younger people who are just beginning their working lives.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
instruction_line: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.
key_points: Both views must be covered separately, with an own opinion clearly stated at the end
In favour of older workers: the experience and steadiness that come with years, knowledge passed on to younger workers, and someone who wants to keep working maintaining their income and connections
In favour of younger workers: those without work experience struggle to get a first job, they adapt quickly to new methods, and long-term unemployment among the young causes lasting harm later on
The own opinion must be justified: the assumption that the number of jobs is fixed can be questioned; it can also be argued that the two generations may not want the same jobs
A concrete example of an industry should be given; generalising by age should be avoided
common_mistakes: Describing both views without stating an own opinion
Letting the discussion drift into the retirement-age debate and losing the hiring question
Putting all older or all younger workers into a single mould
